messages:
Mira: Day 3 check-in — what I did: finished PR updating the onboarding README (https://git.redwood/handbook/onboarding), installed devkit, generated SSH key. Blockers: still can't access #dedicated-gpu channel, SSO to redwood-dev console returns 403, and VS Code debugger fails with EACCES when launching. Today: pair with mentor on a small bug, get infra access, finish security training.

Devon: Hey Mira — can you paste the exact SSO error and the time it happened? I see IT ticket #4567 but it's still unassigned. I'll ping infra now.

Mira: SSO error copy: "403 Forbidden — request id 4f2b-9c". Also when trying to ssh to bastion: 
```
$ ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa ubuntu@bastion.redwood.internal
Permission denied (publickey)
```
Tried re-uploading the public key in profile.

Sam: I tweaked the bastion ACLs and added you to redwood-dev-gpu group. Can you try: `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa && ssh -v ubuntu@bastion.redwood.internal` ? Also I granted temporary Slack access to #dedicated-gpu, you should be able to join now :eyes:

Mira: ssh-add succeeded and I can connect :tada: Joined the channel okay. Still hitting SSO 403 for the console though.

Devon: Escalated to SSO team (INC-7891). In the meantime you can use the VPN workaround — download the client from corp tools and run `openvpn --config /tmp/redwood-dev.ovpn` (keep the session up for KMS console access). I'll DM the VPN profile.

Jordan: Thanks for the updates — great progress. Quick note: pairing with @Devon at 2pm PT to walk through the first task. If SSO isn't resolved by then we'll use the VPN for the demo.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: complete the "Security Basics" course to unlock KMS & private repo access https://training.redwood/security-basics

Mira: Got it — I'll finish the course now and try the VPN. Will post back here once SSO resolves or if anything else blocks me."
